descriptionEn: Apartment for sale with an area of 81.15m², located in Fushë Kosovë, on Rruga Pajazit Islami, near the Eli Abi market.
The apartment is part of a building by Model Slovenia and is located in a practical location for everyday living, with easy access to services and main roads.

The space is well organised and consists of a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom, one storage room and one balcony. The layout makes the apartment suitable for family living, but also for investment.
An important advantage is that the apartment has an ownership certificate and is currently rented out, with the option of continuing the lease for buyers seeking immediate income from the property.

Location: Rr. Pajazit Islami, Fushë Kosovë
Builder: Model Slovenia
Area: 81.15m²
Price: €75,000
